products.notes: Owner's manual spec page: line output voltage 4 V RMS, line output impedance 200 ohms. Product page: 3 pair preamp outputs (front + rear + sub), 10-band EQ with 7 presets. CEA-2006 S/N 75 dBA is for the speaker outputs (1 W into 4 ohms), not the line outputs. 7in wireless CarPlay/Android Auto receiver.

Owner's manual spec page: line output voltage 2 V RMS, line output impedance 200 ohms. Product page: 3 pair preamp outputs (front + rear + sub), 10-band EQ with 7 presets. CEA-2006 S/N 80 dBA refers to speaker outputs. 10.1in floating-screen mech-less receiver.

Owner's manual (version B) spec page: line output voltage 2 V RMS, line output impedance 200 ohms. Product page: 3 pair preamp outputs (front + rear + sub), 8-band graphic EQ with 8 presets. Audio menu has Time Alignment (3 presets, distance-based), loudness, subwoofer on/off and sub gain -6..+6; no crossover frequency settings documented. CEA-2006 S/N 80 dBA refers to speaker outputs.
